enter_sequence.speaker: CROSS
enter_sequence.text: You kids crawled all the way up Cross Tower. I'm flattered — and offended.

defeat_sequence.text: The precincts, the permits, the payoffs — that was all me. The Flats stayed hungry because I kept the lid screwed on.

defeat_sequence.speaker: CROSS
defeat_sequence.text: I didn't invent the Seven Sorrows. I just made sure the city looked the other way.

defeat_sequence.speaker: CROSS
defeat_sequence.text: Spare me and I can still bury a warrant. Kill me and every camera in this tower starts screaming your names.
